reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and unlink primitive, and Fintegra reuses bank selection and sync processing, though its linking and download workflows copy existing implementations.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the account upgrade/create/import/notification workflow and the authenticated transaction download workflow.

placement.why: Account orchestration, transaction downloads, endpoint configuration and provider models remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested linking and provider changes, their tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking rules help maintenance, but duplicated provider workflows and destructive mutations inside an assertion-named helper obscure ownership and sequencing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six linking handlers call assertBankAccountNotLinked, and both takeover and ordinary unlinking use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts linkFintegraAccount repeats the existing provider linking workflow with substituted fields; sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions with provider substitutions and a reshaped response variable.

abstraction_drift.where: Across the changes, assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target rejection and replacement handling, evolving from validation into an operation that unlinks accounts while retaining its assertion name.
